name: History lists runs and a view's space limit can be changed

steps.text: Open the app's home page and click 'History' in the sidebar
At least one sync run of 'Desktop test' is listed with a date and a result
The view 'Archive' is listed with its space limit choices (5 GB to 250 GB)
In the 'Archive' view choose the 50 GB space limit
50 GB is now the selected space limit for 'Archive'
